title: ReTV Bridge is running
tabs.label: Sections
first.title: What TV do you have?
first.lead: This decides what you will need. You can change it any time with the tabs at the top.
first.android.sub: Xiaomi, TCL, Haier, Sony, boxes like the Mi Box. You set it up on the ReTV site; Bridge passes the commands on.
first.samsung.sub: Set up right in this window, step by step. Nothing to download.
first.unknown.sub: Bridge will look for a Samsung TV on your network. If it finds none, open the Android TV tab.
first.hint: Bridge works only on your home network
tv.connected.sub: The ReTV site can work with it.
tv.none.sub: Open the ReTV site and connect your TV there.
code.label: Code for the site
code.lead: The site asks for it once, when you connect a TV.
code.none: Open the ReTV site: it will ask for a code
closeNote: You can close this window: Bridge stays in the menu bar (the TV icon).
closeNote.win: You can close this window: Bridge stays in the notification area (the TV icon).
adb.title: Android tools needed
adb.consent: To send commands to an Android TV, Bridge needs Google's Android tools (about {size} MB). Download them?
adb.failed.title: The download failed
adb.failed: Check your internet connection and press “Retry”, or download the archive yourself and choose it.
adb.startFailed.title: The Android tools did not start
adb.startFailed: Press “Retry”. If that does not help, restart the computer.
port.busy.title: Bridge is already open elsewhere
port.busy: A second copy of ReTV Bridge seems to be running (for example one started from Terminal). Close it, then press “Restart Bridge”.
port.busy.tech: Technical: port 5577 on this computer is in use.
lan.title: No access to the home network
lan.denied: Allow ReTV Bridge to access the local network: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network.
lan.hint: If access is already allowed, check that the computer is on your home network, not only on a VPN.
pairing.title: The site asked for too many codes
firetv.title: Fire TV found: turn on ADB debugging
firetv.found: A Fire TV is on your network. Do this with its remote, then Bridge connects to it by itself.
firetv.s1: Settings › My Fire TV › About: press OK 7 times on the first line, until it says «You are now a developer».
firetv.s2: Go back › Developer options › ADB debugging: turn it on.
firetv.s3: Restart the Fire TV: My Fire TV › Restart, or hold Select and Play for 5 seconds.
firetv.s4: After the restart, press any button on the remote so the Fire TV finds it again.
firetv.s5: On the TV screen, tick «Always allow from this computer» and press OK.
quit.confirm: Bridge is working with a TV. Quit?
log.lead: Bridge writes down everything it does here.
log.hint: Send this to support if something does not work
tray.showCode: Show the code for the site
lang.label: Language
update.busy: Finish setting up the TV first
update.latest: ReTV Bridge is up to date
update.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again later.
update.installFailed: Couldn't install the update. Try again later.
notify.hidden: ReTV Bridge keeps running in the notification area
samsung.find.title: Looking for your Samsung TV
samsung.find.lead: Turn the TV on. It and this computer must be on the same home network.
samsung.pick.title: Which TV are we setting up?
samsung.pick.current: This is the TV being set up. You can pick another.
samsung.none.title: No TV found
samsung.none.text: The TV is on (not in standby). The TV and the computer are on the same Wi-Fi network. VPN is off on the computer.
samsung.ip.label: Or enter the TV's address
samsung.ip.help: On the TV: [[Settings → General → Network → Network Status → IP Settings]], the “IP Address” line.
samsung.dev.title: Turn on Developer Mode on the TV
samsung.dev.1: Press ((⌂)) on the remote and open “Apps”.
samsung.dev.2sub: No number keys? Press ((123)) and type on the screen.
samsung.dev.4: In the [[Host PC IP]] field enter:
samsung.dev.4sub: This computer's address: through it Bridge installs ReTV and removes unneeded apps. ReTV on the TV offers 127.0.0.1 only for removing apps without a computer; Bridge then asks for this address back.
samsung.dev.5: Press [[OK]], then hold ((⏻)) until the TV restarts.
samsung.ipbox.label: This computer's address
samsung.ipbox.sub: Type the digits and dots with the remote
samsung.noMacIp: This computer has no address on the home network. Connect it to the same network as the TV.
samsung.dev.waitSub: Checking every 5 seconds. Bridge moves on by itself.
samsung.dev.other.title: The TV expects another computer
samsung.dev.other.ban: Host PC IP holds another address
samsung.dev.other.text: The TV has `{ip}`. Erase it and enter this computer's address.
samsung.dev.loop.text: That is how ReTV removes apps right on the TV, without a computer. For Bridge to work with the TV, enter this computer's address instead: you can then remove unneeded apps here, in Bridge.
samsung.dev.other.2: In the [[Host PC IP]] field erase the old address and enter:
samsung.dev.other.3: Press [[OK]] and restart the TV: hold ((⏻)).
samsung.dev.ready.title: The TV is ready
samsung.dev.ready.lead: Next, a Samsung account sign-in: without it the TV will not run ReTV Home.
samsung.cert.title: Sign in to your Samsung account
samsung.cert.lead: Samsung runs apps from outside its store only with a permission issued for that one TV. Bridge gets it for you.
samsung.cert.1: A Samsung page opens in your browser.
samsung.cert.2: Sign in with your Samsung account (the one on the TV, or any other).
samsung.cert.3: Come back here: Bridge does the rest.
samsung.cert.privacy: You sign in on Samsung's site. Bridge receives only the permission for this TV and keeps it on this computer.
samsung.cert.create: No Samsung account? Create one for free
samsung.cert.wait: Waiting for you to sign in on Samsung's page
samsung.cert.waitSub: The page is open in your browser. You can leave this window open.
samsung.cert.waitLead: After you sign in, the browser shows “ReTV: signed in”. You can close that tab.
samsung.cert.reopenHint: The page did not open, or you closed it by mistake? Open it again.
samsung.cert.ok: Samsung permission for this TV received
samsung.install.title: Let's install ReTV Home
samsung.install.lead: ReTV Home is the ReTV app on the TV. Installing usually takes less than a minute.
samsung.install.workingLead: Keep the TV on. Usually less than a minute.
samsung.install.s.prepare: Preparing ReTV Home for this TV
samsung.install.ok: ReTV Home is installed and open on the TV
samsung.install.conflictTitle: ReTV Home is already on the TV
samsung.install.conflictBan: It was installed from another computer or another account
samsung.install.conflict: Samsung does not let us replace that copy. We can remove it and install again. ReTV Home's settings and its sign-in on the TV will reset; the TV's other apps are not touched.
samsung.install.conflictOr: Or sign in with the Samsung account you used last time.
samsung.apps.title: Remove unused apps?
samsung.apps.lead: We ticked the ones never opened. You can get them back from the Samsung store. Netflix, YouTube and Gallery are never ticked: your call.
samsung.apps.confirmSub: We keep a “before” list on this computer. The apps can be installed again from the Samsung store.
samsung.apps.empty: Nothing to remove: there are no unused apps on the TV.
samsung.apps.before: The “before” list is saved on this computer. The apps can be installed again from the Samsung store.
samsung.privacy.pairText: Bridge walks through Samsung's ad settings for you, as if pressing the remote. The TV asks for permission once.
samsung.privacy.pairing: Look at the TV and choose [[Allow]]
samsung.privacy.ready: Bridge opens ReTV Home on the TV. ReTV Home checks the ad setting and, if ads are on, opens Samsung's privacy screen. Bridge presses the buttons there, then ReTV Home checks again.
samsung.privacy.readyNote: Leave the remote alone until Bridge is done. If Samsung's «agree to all» turns everything on first, Bridge goes through it once more.
samsung.privacy.accountHint: Sign in to ReTV here and on the TV with the same account, and Bridge sees what ReTV Home reads. Otherwise Bridge asks you what the TV shows.
samsung.privacy.readingTitle: ReTV Home is checking the ad setting
samsung.privacy.reading: ReTV Home opens on the TV and reads the setting. If ads are on, it opens Samsung's privacy screen.
samsung.privacy.checking: ReTV Home opens on the TV and reads the setting after the change.
samsung.privacy.secondRound: One more round: «agree to all» turned everything on, now Bridge turns it all off.
samsung.privacy.askScreenTitle: What is on the TV now?
samsung.privacy.askResultTitle: What does ReTV Home show now?
samsung.privacy.noReport: Bridge did not hear from ReTV Home through your account. Look at the TV:
samsung.privacy.tvSignIn: Sign in to ReTV on the TV: on the TV open ReTV settings → Sign in, a code appears on the screen.
samsung.privacy.openYourself: Until the TV is signed in to ReTV, open Samsung's screen yourself: in ReTV Home arrow up → the gear top right → «Speed up and clean the TV» → «Tracking and ads» → «Open Samsung settings».
samsung.privacy.pickTitle: Which TV in your account is this?
samsung.privacy.pickLead: Bridge cannot tell which Samsung TV of your account is in front of you.
samsung.privacy.pickNone: This TV is not in the list
samsung.privacy.pickNone.sub: Bridge will ask you what the TV shows
samsung.privacy.a.onAfter.sub: Bridge goes through it once more
samsung.privacy.a.unknown.sub: We show you how to turn them off yourself
samsung.privacy.why.notOpened: Samsung's privacy screen did not open on the TV, so Bridge pressed nothing.
samsung.privacy.why.unexpected: The TV showed something Bridge did not expect, so it pressed nothing more.
samsung.privacy.why.launchFailed: ReTV Home did not open on the TV.
samsung.privacy.why.keysFailed: The TV's remote stopped answering while Bridge was pressing buttons.
samsung.err.retvNotOpened.title: ReTV Home did not open
samsung.err.retvNotOpened: The TV refused to open ReTV Home. Check that it is installed and try again.
samsung.privacy.pressing: Bridge is pressing buttons on Samsung's settings screen. You will see the highlight move.
samsung.privacy.doneAlready: Interest-based ads were already off. Bridge pressed nothing.
samsung.privacy.manual: On Samsung's privacy screen open [[Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy]], untick viewing information and interest-based ads, and press [[OK]].
samsung.done.title: The TV is ready
samsung.done.removedSub: The “before” list is saved on this computer
samsung.done.adsManual: Turn interest-based ads off on the TV yourself
samsung.done.adsKept: Ad settings left as they were
samsung.done.note: You can leave Developer Mode on: it lets this computer update ReTV Home.
samsung.status.devOff: Developer Mode is off on this TV.
samsung.status.needCert: The TV is ready. Next: Samsung sign-in.
samsung.status.installed: ReTV Home is installed and open on the TV
samsung.status.removedSome: Some apps were not removed. Try again.
samsung.err.devOff.title: The TV does not accept commands
samsung.err.devOff: Check that Developer Mode is on and the TV was restarted after turning it on. Bridge carries on by itself.
samsung.err.hostIp.title: The TV did not let this computer in
samsung.err.hostIp: Check that [[Host PC IP]] holds this computer's address, and restart the TV.
samsung.err.sdb.title: The connection to the TV dropped
samsung.err.sdb: Turn the TV on if it went off: Bridge carries on by itself.
samsung.err.tv.title: The TV stopped responding
samsung.err.tv: It may have turned off or gone to standby. Turn the TV on: Bridge carries on by itself.
samsung.err.tooMany.title: Samsung asks us to wait
samsung.err.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in an hour.
samsung.err.samsung.title: Samsung did not issue the permission
samsung.err.wrongCert.title: No Samsung permission yet
samsung.err.wrongCert: This TV has no permission yet. Sign in to your Samsung account to get it.
samsung.err.install.title: The TV did not install ReTV Home
samsung.err.install: Try again. If that does not help, restart the TV.
samsung.err.otherAuthor.title: ReTV Home is already on the TV
samsung.err.otherAuthor: It was installed from another computer or account, and the TV refuses to install over it.
samsung.err.other.title: Something went wrong
samsung.err.other: Try again. If that does not help, send the log to support.
samsung.err.remoteDenied.title: The TV did not allow the remote
samsung.err.remoteDenied: Allow ReTV Bridge in the TV's settings and try again:
samsung.err.remoteTimeout.title: The TV did not answer in time
samsung.err.remoteTimeout: Press “Try again” and choose [[Allow]] on the TV.
samsung.err.remoteDown.title: The TV's remote did not connect
samsung.err.remoteDown: Check that the TV is on and try again.
samsung.err.badIp: That is not a home network address. It looks like this: 192.168.1.20
samsung.err.port.title: Couldn't receive Samsung's answer
samsung.err.port: Another program is in the way. Close the second copy of ReTV Bridge and press “Retry”.
samsung.err.port.tech: Technical: port 4794 on this computer is in use.
samsung.err.noWgt: This build of Bridge has no ReTV Home for Samsung.
samsung.err.devClosed.title: The TV closed developer access
samsung.err.devClosed: Open “Apps”, type ((1)) ((2)) ((3)) ((4)) ((5)) and check that [[Developer mode]] = [[On]] and the address is `{ip}`. Press [[OK]] and restart the TV: hold the power button ((⏻)) until the Samsung logo shows. Bridge carries on by itself.
samsung.apps.builtinRefused: Samsung does not let these go: {names} (built-in apps)
samsung.apps.builtinSub: We will not offer them again. Samsung may bring e-Manual back after the TV restarts.
samsung.install.alreadyText: It is already on this TV. You can update it to the version in Bridge or go on.
samsung.signin.done: ReTV: signed in. You can close this tab and return to ReTV Bridge.
samsung.signin.retry: ReTV: Samsung did not send what we need. Return to ReTV Bridge and try again.
acct.offline: Can't reach {host}. You stay signed in.
acct.sheet.title: Sign in to ReTV
acct.sheet.lead: Bridge will show your plan and your TVs. You never type a password into Bridge: you sign in on the ReTV site.
acct.step.opened: The ReTV site is open in your browser
acct.step.opened.sub: No new tab? Click “Open the site again”.
acct.step.allow: Sign in and click “Allow ReTV Bridge”
acct.step.allow.sub: Any way of signing in on the site works.
acct.waiting: Waiting for you to confirm on the site
acct.waiting.sub: This window sees the answer by itself.
acct.code.label: Code, if the site asks
acct.code.go: Or open `{go}` on any device and type this code.
acct.code.never: Don't tell anyone this code. ReTV staff never ask for it.
acct.cellMenu.label: Where your ReTV account is
acct.cell.hint: Accounts on retv.app and ru.retv.app are separate. Pick the one you signed up on.
acct.done.title: Done, you're signed in
acct.done: Bridge shows your account at the top of the window. You can sign out there or in the Bridge icon's menu.
acct.err.denied.title: Sign-in declined
acct.err.denied: Someone clicked “This was not me” on the site. If it was you, start again.
acct.err.expired.title: The code has expired
acct.err.expired: A code lasts 10 minutes. Start again and Bridge shows a new one.
acct.err.network.title: Can't reach the site
acct.err.network: Bridge couldn't reach {host}. Check the internet and try again.
acct.err.rateLimited.title: Too many tries
acct.err.rateLimited: Wait a little and try again.
acct.err.server.title: The site answered with an error
acct.tvs.title: Your TVs in ReTV
acct.tvs.none: No TVs in your account yet.
acct.tvs.signIn: Sign in to see your TVs here
